title: Mirror Writing
statement:
Leonardo liked to write his notes backwards so that they could only be read in a mirror. You want to do the same with your secret word.

Given a word **s**, print it reversed: the last letter first and the first letter last.
input: One line with the word **s**, made of lowercase English letters.
constraints: s contains only the letters a to z
hints: Loop from the last index down to index 0 and print each character.
editorial:
Read the string and output its characters from the last one to the first one. In C++ you can call `reverse(s.begin(), s.end())`; in Python `s[::-1]` does it.

Complexity: O(n).
